audio.title: Happy speech
audio.description: The right participant’s speech is edited toward a happy delivery. Observe the left participant in the 0.00–4.19 s listening interval. The emotion edit uses Step-Audio-EditX.

audio.title: Sad speech
audio.description: The left participant’s speech is edited toward a sad delivery. Observe the right participant in the 2.00–5.16 s listening interval. The emotion edit uses Step-Audio-EditX.

audio.title: Speaker muting
audio.description: The right participant’s audio is replaced with silence; the left audio is retained. The left woman no longer makes the head turn seen in the baseline. Shared comparison interval: 0–7.875 s.

audio.title: A one-second audio shift
audio.description: The left audio is delayed by 1 s, with silence prepended; the right audio is retained. The wider mouth-opening motion before speech described in the response occurs in the left participant, whose audio is edited.

text.title: Text comparison 1
text.description: Compare each instruction with the baseline. The two instructions address different participants: the right participant and the left participant, respectively.

text.title: Text comparison 2

groupClips.title: Gaze during listening

groupClips.description: Source interval: 4.00–10.21 s. The central participant speaks at 4.56–6.48 s; the participant in a black coat starts at 6.72 s. The central participant later turns toward her.
